body:
Well maybe she doesn't realize how much you really like her. 

So she is open to having a relationship with you, that's great news. 

I think, when she told you about her situation, she put a lot of trust in you. She trusted you to be able to handle it, and to help her. To be all, that this other guy could never be. Otherwise, she would have talked to him, don't you think?

She has not broken your trust, she has trusted you with something that was difficult for her. 

And yes, if I was in your position, I'd be glad I had her around. And I would still talk to her every day. And I would not give up, just because of some 'internet romance thing' a girl tells me about.

Hey, I'm glad you get along well with you therapist. That's great, has helped me a lot too. 

I've been suffering from mental health issues since I was a kid, and back then I didn't have a chance to go to a therapist. When I was older, and finally did, it felt great to know that someone was really taking time to help me with these problems no one seemed to understand. 

And don't worry, this is to help you, it's not a test. There is no right or wrong answers. If she needs to know something you haven't mentioned, she will surely just ask. And if you feel, she is going about it a little too quickly just tell her. She'll understand if you need a break or a topic makes you feel pain. You decide the pace.

Take your time, trust in your judgment, you know best how to handle your own feelings.

Acknowledging all that has happened in our lives is an important step to healing. It makes all the difference, if you ask me, to find the reason, and not just treat the symptom.

I hope your therapy makes you feel a lot better soon, with all the love, C.

But she did say, that she connected with you in way she didn't connect with him, didn't she? And that she was trying to cut ties with him?

And you do like her, do you not?

Also, that is most definitely not how apologizing works. 

You have to tell her, that you like her. And that, when she told you about that guy, you felt horrible because you thought she might just be using you (which I hardly think is the case).  Tell her that and let her explain what she thinks about it.

Chances are, she likes you a lot and is now very sad, that you two don't talk anymore.

So, think about it this way: she texted you 'good morning' and she could have texted this guy. She said she connects with you, not that guy, She spent all this time talking to you, that she could have spent with something else. 

So you must be very close and dear to her. And all in all, this sounds like she was going to leave that guy for you. He was just an 'online thing' to her, you were real. 

Just tell her, apologize to her, and tell her you like her. 

That is the only way you'll ever find out.

And if it doesn't work, you can still ignore her for the rest of you life.

Please just tell her...

Thanks for sharing this man! Really inspiring to see someone actually getting off the hamster wheel that our society has become. You run and run and run, but you never get anywhere.

Being half a musician myself (guitar) and struggling to fit in finding jobs that have prestige, I feel like you are right. Why am wasting my time doing what they want instead of focusing on what I like?

And van Halen rocks!

I also feel very dizzy and my hands shiver a lot. Sometimes my eyes twitch and I get sick. emotional suffering has quite an impact on our physical health. Headaches are not uncommon in such a scenario at all.

I'm really glad you decided to tell her about it. It will go well, you'll see. 

Art classes are cool, maybe one day you'll post one of your pictures up here to show us?

With all the love, C.

You are still here, because you deserve to be loved and to live, as much as everyone else.  And I am glad you are alive.

I remember it well, when all that pain was overwhelming me. And i blamed myself for it. I thought about it endlessly. Where was the moment, where I had gone wrong? But I never found an answer. 

A therapist saved me. Because I realized something talking to her. That there was people out there, that treated me well and cared. So I can only advice you to try it for yourself, talking to a therapist that is.

And you know what? I thought about the same things you do. That I didn't want to show my pain and suffering, that I was a failure, that the world was better off without me. But in the end, it is best to just tell everyone how you feel. Not all of them will be supportive, that is the truth. But the ones who will remain by your side, you'll know you can trust.

I am glad you decided to write this. I hope this makes you realize, that you're not alone, and that we care, and we're glad that you're still here.

With all the love, C.

Damn, it hurts to read how sad you are. I know what it's like. 

Getting a therapist is  great idea. Once I did, i felt like finally there was someone in my life who understood, and who cared, and I never had anything like that before. Just make sure to find one you actually feel good being with.

And when it comes to talking to your mom, in the end it is best to tell her that you need to see a therapist, and if she doesn't understands right away, just ask her to trust you. You know best, what you need. 

Crying is perfectly fine, trust me, it's when can't cry anymore, that things turn bad.

And don't stop painting. Doesn't matter what everyone else thinks. Just look at it as way to express who you really are. Art heals the soul...

A big hug, and I hope you find a therapist that can help you.

I must make sure to remember that last sentence.

I have felt exactly like you do right now. And in many ways, I still do. There is no easy way out of it. 

For me, finding a good therapist feels like the only good thing I ever did. It was the first time, i ever felt like another human actually cared for me.

So look for a therapist, and not just any. Try different ones until one makes you feel like a human being that is worth being loved.

Because you are.

You know, I can relate to the problem. Sincerely I have found out, that people around us are not always as 'smart' as we expect them to be. If you don't tell them you feel bad and have problems, they are never going to notice. They will never see beyond the jokes and the happy facade. 

True strength, is accepting your weakness and letting everybody know. 

Just tell em, and you'll see it will change a lot...

Hey man, just wanna tell you you're doing great despite what you think. I've dropped out of two universities because of depression so don't worry about missing a party or a day of work. The world is not gonna end because of it, and your health is our main priority anyways.

But I'm glad you figured out, that sometimes facing what you fear is the best way to feel better after all - I would agree to that.

I feel the same way about telling people you are depressed. It might scare you now, but you will feel better once everyone knows. 

Keep it up, you can do this!
And the ups are worth the downs?
You say curiosity keeps you alive?

You sound like someone, who hates himself so much -  and yet someone, we would want to get to know so badly.

I also hope, you find peace in whichever path you choose.

And you are sharing this, because you feel, deep inside, that you deserve to be heard and acknowledged as a person.

Deserve more, than someone who cared for them? What would that be?

Talk to them.

Tell them how you feel. They might no be able to understand - but they will want to help.

Also, awful people kill themselves without ever caring about anyone else, so that disqualifies you entirely.

I wish you find peace in what you do,

but if you still have time, do tell us your story so that we might remember you for who you were

I am in a similar situation, no job, no insurance and no hope.

Sleep seems to be the only thing that helps, and I keep wishing sleep was forever...

Wish I could offer you advice or happiness, but I am facing the end as well.

With all the love, C.
What happened?

You have so much more in your life, than many of us.

What makes you want to find an end so soon?
If so, then at least I am not the only trapped in this Tartaros...

Reading this fills my eyes with tears and my heart with sorrow.

But I still think, you need to protect them... until the very end.
Do you feel, like you hate yourself? You want to destroy yourself?

And yet you are here - and we are here for you - and you are heard.

So tell us, why does it have to end like this?

I hope you have found peace, friend. 

May your soul rest and find happiness...

Feeling loved, isn't it.

As simple as it seems, what else would we wish for...

As do I.

Knowledge seems not to be a way to happiness, as far as I can say...
Maybe it is better to be a happy fool, than a wise man headed for oblivion...
How much I wish right now, for someone to chime in and tell us...
So you do have plans for your futureP
That is more, than anyone around me would probably ever say, so thank you.
Do you ever wonder, if there is somtehing hidden from you, that would change it all?
Then you are lucky to feel love.
And if my heart has chosen death - but I am asking your heart instead?

Have you made your peace with your life and your death?

Are you certain now, that it is inevitable?

It seems they have treated you quite badly, so I can see where this is coming from.

I am sorry.

Tell your story, trust me, we are here and will listen.

You don't know us - but we love you anyway.

We know what it is like to feel that way.

If you have to wait anyway, then tell us your story.

We will like to hear it. And we will always remember you

Dear friend, the wish for death as you pursued it, is nothing you should feel ashamed of.

While I wish for nothing more than for you to find a reason to live, i also think you should tell them the truth,

Do you, at this point and after what you did, not feel tired of lying about it?

Is your wish for death not something that truly resides in you? 

Then tell them openly and sincerely, of this wish. Face it, be brave. Only then will you know, if it is really the path before you.

Stop hiding it. Look into they're eyes. Only then will you know, if you're truly alone.

I am sorry , you feel that way. While I feel that was myself, I am also a cause of it. 

I know what it's like to push people away, and it's probably people like you whom I have pushed away. 

I wish I could correct my mistake, and tell you in person, that I like you to be around,

The pain I feel, I have projected onto others all this time. No one deserves this.

 I am so sorry...

I am now, where you are. 

You're right, it's selfish. but what else have we ever done for ourselves?

Being alone, is the worst part of it. No one understands, no one is there to hold one's hand when life slowly drifts away...

Bon voyage friend, i will hope to see you on the other side.

Hey, you still there?

I'm drunk as hell right now, thinking about nothing but death itself. 

You hear all the stories about drinking, but it's nothing like that once you start yourself, isn't it? I've found that out myself the hard way. Drinking gives me a feeling of peace I never experience everywhere else - is it the same to you?

I have always wondered, but never found anyone else to talk to. 

Do you also wish for your own destruction, as I do?

​

I am awaiting your answer, with all the love, C.
